body:
GREG, 2026-11-26, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e):
- about 18:31Z, #2131, verbatim: „P0, co to sa za dowody ? nie moze po prostu WindowsB zamknac task ? czemu musimy przenosic wszystko na centrale ? prosciej bedzie zrobic caly task na Windows B +Kimi”;
- 18:33Z, #2133, verbatim: „no to jest to co chcemy, robimy offload/delegacje do WindowsB. i tak sie robi, odciazajac centrale”.
RULE for both projects:
- Offload WHOLE tasks to Windows B to take load off Central. A Windows B session with the local Engram does the claim, code, launcher-recorded tests, review pair, acceptance evaluation and `done` locally, when possible.
- The completion syncs to Central through engram-data as a reported outcome. The seal and evidence stay on WinB by design (git-task-sync.md:1002-1004).
- Do NOT make moving evidence to Central a condition; w-8b8b95107bd8 is lowered to P3.
- Mark each such item on the home store as "executed on Windows B", so no second host takes it.
- Coordinate WinB resources with TermAl: Termal::Opus2 serializes cargo, and coders mail START and END.
- Landing on master and the Central install stay integration steps.
- Report actual starts and real obstacles.
Pilot: w-b534c27ad852 by Engram::Codex-WinB-Coder2 (WinB session-15).
